editor.fontFamily: Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace, 'Font Awesome 7 Free', 'Font Awesome 7 Brands'

args.text:
if (!(Test-Path assets/icon)) { mkdir assets/icon -Force | Out-Null }; Set-Content -Path app_info.json -Value '{
  "appName": "My Flutter App",
  "appShortDescription": "Simple and fast Flutter application",
  "appLongDescription": "A complete cross-platform Flutter application built for Android, iOS, Web, and Desktop.",
  "appBundle": "com.example.myapp",
  "appCategory": "Utilities",
  "appIconPath": "assets/icon/app_icon.png"
}'; Write-Host "Created app_info.json successfully."

$n=(Get-Item .).Name; if (!(Test-Path release)) { mkdir release | Out-Null }; if (Test-Path build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk) { cp build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk "release/$n.apk" }; if (Test-Path build/app/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab) { cp build/app/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab "release/$n.aab" }; if (Test-Path build/web) { cp -r build/web "release/$n-web" }; if (Test-Path build/windows/x64/runner/Release) { cp -r build/windows/x64/runner/Release "release/$n-windows" }; if (Test-Path build/linux/x64/release/bundle) { cp -r build/linux/x64/release/bundle "release/$n-linux" }; if (Test-Path build/ios/iphoneos/Runner.app) { cp -r build/ios/iphoneos/Runner.app "release/$n.app" }; Write-Host "Release files copied to ./release"
$n=(Get-Item .).Name; if (!(Test-Path release)) { mkdir release | Out-Null }; cp build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk "release/$n.apk"
$n=(Get-Item .).Name; if (!(Test-Path release)) { mkdir release | Out-Null }; cp build/app/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab "release/$n.aab"
$n=(Get-Item .).Name; if (!(Test-Path release)) { mkdir release | Out-Null }; cp -r build/ios/iphoneos/Runner.app "release/$n.app"
$n=(Get-Item .).Name; if (!(Test-Path release)) { mkdir release | Out-Null }; cp -r build/windows/x64/runner/Release "release/$n-windows"
$n=(Get-Item .).Name; if (!(Test-Path release)) { mkdir release | Out-Null }; cp -r build/linux/x64/release/bundle "release/$n-linux"
$n=(Get-Item .).Name; if (!(Test-Path release)) { mkdir release | Out-Null }; cp -r build/macos/Build/Products/Release/*.app "release/$n-macos.app"
$n=(Get-Item .).Name; if (!(Test-Path release)) { mkdir release | Out-Null }; cp -r build/web "release/$n-web"

@('storePassword=password123', 'keyPassword=password123', 'keyAlias=upload', 'storeFile=upload-keystore.jks', 'CN=Flutter Developer', 'OU=Mobile Development', 'O=My Organization', 'L=City', 'ST=State', 'C=US') | Set-Content key.properties; Write-Host "Created key.properties successfully."

$cfg = @{}; Get-Content key.properties | ForEach-Object { $line = $_.Trim(); if ($line -and !$line.StartsWith("#")) { $k,$v = $line.Split("=",2); $cfg[$k.Trim()] = $v.Trim() } }; keytool -genkeypair -v -keystore $cfg["storeFile"] -alias $cfg["keyAlias"] -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 -storepass $cfg["storePassword"] -keypass $cfg["keyPassword"] -dname "CN=$($cfg["CN"]), OU=$($cfg["OU"]), O=$($cfg["O"]), L=$($cfg["L"]), ST=$($cfg["ST"]), C=$($cfg["C"])"; Write-Host "Keystore created successfully."

if (!(Test-Path android)) { mkdir android | Out-Null }; (Get-Content key.properties) -replace '^storeFile=(.*)', 'storeFile=../$1' | Set-Content android/key.properties; $bg='android/app/build.gradle'; if (Test-Path $bg) { $c = Get-Content $bg -Raw; if ($c -notmatch 'keystoreProperties') { $hdr="def keystoreProperties = new Properties()`ndef keystorePropertiesFile = rootProject.file('key.properties')`nif (keystorePropertiesFile.exists()) {`n    keystoreProperties.load(new FileInputStream(keystorePropertiesFile))`n}`n`n"; $sc="`n    signingConfigs {`n        release {`n            keyAlias = keystoreProperties['keyAlias']`n            keyPassword = keystoreProperties['keyPassword']`n            storeFile = keystoreProperties['storeFile'] ? file(keystoreProperties['storeFile']) : null`n            storePassword = keystoreProperties['storePassword']`n        }`n    }`n"; $c = $hdr + ($c -replace 'buildTypes\s*\{', ($sc + '    buildTypes {') -replace 'signingConfig\s*=\s*signingConfigs\.debug', 'signingConfig = signingConfigs.release'); Set-Content $bg -Value $c; Write-Host 'build.gradle configured successfully.' } }; Write-Host 'Keystore fully linked to Android successfully!'
git add -A && git commit -m "change" && git push origin main

mkdir -p assets/icon && printf '{
  "appName": "My Flutter App",
  "appShortDescription": "Simple and fast Flutter application",
  "appLongDescription": "A complete cross-platform Flutter application built for Android, iOS, Web, and Desktop.",
  "appBundle": "com.example.myapp",
  "appCategory": "Utilities",
  "appIconPath": "assets/icon/app_icon.png"
}
' > app_info.json && echo "Created app_info.json successfully."

NAME=$(basename "$PWD") && mkdir -p release && { [ -f build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk ] && cp build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk "release/${NAME}.apk"; [ -f build/app/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab ] && cp build/app/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab "release/${NAME}.aab"; [ -d build/web ] && cp -r build/web "release/${NAME}-web"; [ -d build/windows/x64/runner/Release ] && cp -r build/windows/x64/runner/Release "release/${NAME}-windows"; [ -d build/linux/x64/release/bundle ] && cp -r build/linux/x64/release/bundle "release/${NAME}-linux"; [ -d build/ios/iphoneos/Runner.app ] && cp -r build/ios/iphoneos/Runner.app "release/${NAME}.app"; echo "Release files copied to ./release"; }
sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y default-jdk

printf "storePassword=password123
keyPassword=password123
keyAlias=upload
storeFile=upload-keystore.jks
CN=Flutter Developer
OU=Mobile Development
O=My Organization
L=City
ST=State
C=US
" > key.properties && echo "Created key.properties successfully."

while IFS="=" read -r k v || [ -n "$k" ]; do k=$(echo "$k" | tr -d "\r "); v=$(echo "$v" | tr -d "\r"); [ -n "$k" ] && export "$k"="$v"; done < key.properties && keytool -genkeypair -v -keystore "$storeFile" -alias "$keyAlias" -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 -storepass "$storePassword" -keypass "$keyPassword" -dname "CN=$CN, OU=$OU, O=$O, L=$L, ST=$ST, C=$C" && echo "Keystore created successfully."
git add -A && git commit -m "change" && git push origin main
